# IQueryProgressReporter

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.IQueryProgressReporter`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Lightweight progress reporter for query plan execution. Defined in the Dataverse layer so it can be used without depending on PPDS.Cli. The CLI&#x27;s IProgressReporter can wrap/adapt this interface.
